# Youngjun Park (박영준)

> Architect and urban data scientist. Co-founder and CTO of ar-ge inc. Ph.D. in Architecture, Seoul National University (2022). Former postdoctoral researcher at KAIST School of Computing (2022–2025) and KAIST Urban AI Institute (2025). Research in urban computing, smart cities, ML/DL for urban analysis, and Agentic AI for architectural and urban design.

Publication byline: **Park, Youngjun**. Korean name: 박영준.

## Identifiers

- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4254-2268
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=sGRKN6UAAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/youngjour
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/youngjourpark
- Email: youngjourpark@gmail.com

## Current affiliations

- [ar-ge inc.](https://ar-ge.kr) — Co-founder and CTO (present).
- KAIST Urban AI Institute — External Advisor (present).

## Education

- Ph.D. in Architecture, Seoul National University, 2022. Dissertation: smartphone-data-based pedestrian activity analysis and urban planning facilities for physical-activity promotion.
- M.S. in Urban Design, Seoul National University, 2017. Thesis: homemakers' automobile use behavior and intra-neighborhood travel characteristics.
- B.S. in Architecture, Seoul National University, 2013.

## Career history

- Co-founder and CTO, ar-ge inc. (ar-ge Architects) — present.
- Postdoctoral Researcher, KAIST Urban AI Institute — 2025.
- Postdoctoral Researcher, KAIST School of Computing — 2022–2025.
- Lecturer, Department of Architecture, Seoul National University — 2021–2024.
- Officer (First Lieutenant), Republic of Korea Army Corps of Engineers — 2013–2015.

## Research projects

- GS–KAIST Smart City Research Center (2024–2025). Postdoctoral Researcher, KAIST. Funded by GS E&C. Industry–academic center on AI-based urban systems and smart-city technologies.
- AI-based Non-contact Drug Detection Technology (2024–2025). Postdoctoral Researcher, KAIST. Ministry of Science and ICT. RS-2024-00459749.
- Multimodal Spatiotemporal Urban Prediction Models Based on Large Language Models (2024–2025). Postdoctoral Researcher, KAIST. National Research Foundation of Korea. RS-2024-00356597.
- Self-Learning Autonomic IoT Edge Computing Technology (2022–2025). Postdoctoral Researcher, SW StarLab long-term project, KAIST. Ministry of Science and ICT. RS-2019-II191126.
- Development of an AI-based Smart Mobility System (2022–2024). Participating Researcher, KAIST. Daegu Metropolitan City. N04230030.
- Text Analysis of Pedestrian-Related Government-Budget Projects (2022–2023). Research service. Architecture & Urban Research Institute (AURI).
- Comparative Study on Walking Practice within Neighborhoods via Individual GPS Trajectory Analysis (2019–2021). Research Grant Recipient, Seoul National University. NRF Next-Generation Researcher Program.
- Pedestrian Data Analysis for WalkON Smartphone App Development (2019–2020). Research Team Lead and External Researcher, Swallaby Inc.
- GIS Analysis for Spatial Welfare of Infants and Young Children (2018–2019). Research Assistant, Department of Architecture, Ewha Womans University.
- Comprehensive Urban Plan for the Huế City ODA Project, Vietnam (2015–2016). Research Assistant, Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), Graduate School of Environmental Studies, Seoul National University.
